items.why: Chip stocks are recovering from steep losses as the Nasdaq rebounds, with AI stocks seeing some buying.
Dip buyers are stepping in as the stock rout pauses, lifting beaten-down names with the broader tape.
AI stocks are seeing some buying as the Nasdaq attempts to recover from its worst rout in 19 months.

summary: Stocks are rebounding after the worst day in 19 months, with the Nasdaq recovering as chip stocks bounce back and a blowout jobs report helps lift the tape.
